# Release Notes

## 0.39.0 — 2026-10-17

- Version: `0.39.0` (MINOR: active PWA photo/receipt review surface; existing course offer carried forward).
- Environment: `production`; implementation PR `#35`, exact SHA `299076e08e6856d1acbb92faa6c464d1fa3bac65`, validation `39034188495`, approved production run `39051445322` (`success`).
- Authoritative activation: `2026-10-17T17:01:07.593704+00:00`; independent SSH readback passed at `2026-10-17T17:05:44.704533+00:00`. All eight services healthy; application containers have zero restarts (retained DB historical count 15).
- Photo pipeline active in bot/API (`PHOTO_PIPELINE_ENABLED=true`, shadow false); transaction metadata migration applied. Receipt source/review/findings/total metadata and separate financial confirmation are retained.
- Required encrypted off-host backup verified (artifact `12107887713`); public root/quiz/key JS match exact source bytes after CRLF normalization; course/PWA HTTP 200, anonymous profile 401; clean application/proxy log windows.
- Course `https://vydno.capital/?start=course` retains server-controlled `askills_course_90d` / 90 days, confirmed card-link/payment and consent gates.
- **ARTIFACT DEPLOYED; DELIVERY INCOMPLETE:** real receipts still show missing dates and one invalid/unresolved currency; strict authenticated upload → real provider → review without confirmation remains unverified. Real-owner Telegram/card/bonus/repeat-login and phone standalone-PWA acceptance are still open. No financial commit or cardholder action was performed.
- Evidence, owner steps and limitations: `code/docs/releases/0.39.0-two-feature-owner-release.md`.
